# NabuLearn

> AI-Powered Literacy Platform. NabuLearn uses 4 proprietary ML models to assess reading fluency, predict at-risk students, and deliver targeted interventions through an RPG reading adventure for K-12.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview and key capabilities.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Pilot, school, and district plans ($5–7/student/year).
- [Interactive Demos](/demos): Student, teacher, parent, and admin role demos.
- [Student Demo](/demos/student): See the AURA reading experience.
- [Teacher Demo](/demos/teacher): Classroom analytics and intervention tools.
- [Parent Demo](/demos/parent): Parent dashboard and progress views.
- [Admin Demo](/demos/admin): District- and school-level administration.
- [Scope & Sequence](/scope-and-sequence): Phonics scope and sequence reference.
- [Sign In / Sign Up](/auth): Account access for schools and students.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): FERPA & COPPA-aligned data practices.
